name: rocut
description: Drive the rocut agent-first video editor through its bundled CLI: start or join a local backend host, show its authenticated editor URL in the workspace Web Pane, edit tracks/clips/assets/markers through revision-checked transaction batches and reviewable drafts (begin/stage/approve/reject/discard) via --target routing, verify structurally by re-reading, and rely on the project directory as the single source of truth. Self-contained: the rocut runtime, its WebAssembly core and the prebuilt editor surface ship with the plugin and run on Elftia's managed Node 20+. No rocut checkout, no bun, no global install.
